data.title: Unit 1 : The Animal World
Types of Animals
data.text: The nose moistens and filters the air we breathe.
The nose has tiny hair inside called cilia. The cilia trap dust particles and other minute objects and keep them from entering our lungs.
The nose helps us to identify the smells around us.
The nose allows us to smell what we are eating.
We sneeze when the inside of our nose is irritated.
